answer: mechanism is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, with penalties priced above any single epoch reward. Verification rights are minted by burning stake, so fake identities cost real capital. If a bogus verifier signs a bad block, its stake is slashed on-ledger instantly, larger than everything it could earn that epoch, and its ripple spreads: any node that delegated stake to it shares the penalty, so proxies have no safe margin. Identity reputation rises with honest uptime like a tide, and an attacker launching thousands of fresh identities starts at the nadir
